title: k6 REST profile: instruments, klines (cold, warm, page-boundary), trades, orderbook, data-coverage (budget #13), and a cold first read in a scenario and on a reader of its own

full.scaling: none: k6, 5 VUs (§9 realistic peak) on the 7 budget routes, 10 min, uvicorn on 127.0.0.1 over the fixture backend; the first read in a k6 scenario of its own, at a fixed arrival rate, on a second server

smoke.scaling: in-process httpx ASGI driver (no sockets, no k6) issuing the same request plan, 40 rounds of the 7 budget routes at concurrency 5 and, beside them, 40 first reads in a pool of their own (nearest-rank p95 is not the max)
